args.message: Revenue and credit totals are calculated separately, so each customer's credit limit is counted once no matter how many orders they placed. Customers who never ordered still add their credit limit to their region's total. The null group combines orders whose customer has no region or isn't a known customer, plus the credit limits of customers without a region.
